name: m4-devirt-subst-prof
description: `SubstMap` step of [retronym/scala#199](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/199): `TypeMap.applyFast` binds `SubstSymMap.apply` and a final `SubstMap.substMapApply` statically, against the previous tip, where the call to `SubstMap.apply` stayed a vtable call. PMU profile (cycles, instructions) through the kperf helper with `jitRecording`, scala corpus, one fork per build: stub attribution plus `jit_diff`. Not a timing A/B.
Both builds with the release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); same JDK, heap and iterations as `m4-devirt-type-prof`.

variantDescriptions.subst: static `SubstSymMap` / `SubstMap` branches on top of it
